old.name: The wine route
old.hook: Half the island is under vine, dry-farmed by the same meltem that turns the wind farm — the route is small enough to ride in a day.
old.text: Half the island is under vine, dry-farmed by the same meltem that turns the wind farm — the route is small enough to ride in a day. Four native grakes carry it: white Çavuş and Vasilaki, red Karalahna and Kuntra. The producers to know are Corvus, Talay, Çamlıbağ and Ataol; because the cellar doors, the harbour and the vines sit in one walkable town, the island itself is the route. Cellar doors in town + the vines · Open in Google Maps →
